metadata.disclaimer: EXPLORATORY analysis on legacy label-adjacent baseline features. Every baseline row operates under label_mode='legacy'. No proposed model rows are reported. Conflict and reliability signals are NOT evaluated until consensus labels exist.

herb_disjoint.tri_state_legacy_status: Under legacy single-study binary labels, the tri-state conformal engine operates without external multi-study conflict annotations; its conformal nonconformity score on single probabilities is monotonically equivalent to max-probability |p - 0.5|. Possessing no separate signal under legacy labels, the tri-state row is dropped from the matched comparison table to avoid redundant duplicate scoring.

gat_retention_decision.rule: Keep SmallGAT only if it beats LR under all three disjoint protocols with p < 0.05
gat_retention_decision.rationale: SmallGAT is REJECTED / DROPPED. Under the retention protocol, SmallGAT must beat Logistic Regression under all three primary disjoint split protocols (herb-disjoint, drug-disjoint, pair-disjoint) with statistical significance (p < 0.05). SmallGAT beats LR in all three: False.
